26 March 2017Pipjam

Very Very Good Product!

Originally posted on clinique.co.uk

Yes, I recommend this

I am quite long in the tooth now and enjoy using a conventional double edge safety razor, along with a shave brush, with either shave cream or soap. However, pre-shave oils whether home made or off the shelf have never given me the "Holy Grail" of the ultimate shave. Having tried this shave cream, I cannot fault it at all, yet I miss the brush and soap. The compromise had arrived. Clinique Cream Shave does the business for me in an unconventional way. I use it as a pre-shave applying it on top of damp bristles using a thin layer rubbing well onto the face, then apply my choice shave soap or cream. The result is fantastic for me. Rinsing off, then a cold water rinse and pat dry your face. Apply your favourite moisturiser if you need. An excellent result. Use Clinique Cream Shave on its own is just as effective but in my opinion and the result using it as a pre-shave I've never experienced any nicks at all. £15.00 is a high cost at first but it goes a very long way saving you money overall. I cannot recommend it high enough either way. Clinique Cream Shave will not disappoint!
